The real problem

## Google Search Console in Claude instead of CSV exports

Search Console answers one filtered question at a time. Your agent answers the one you actually have.

Before · export, filter, match, repeat [...] Problem 1

### Search Console shows 1,000 rows at a time

The Performance report caps every table at 1,000 rows, so the long, specific queries that AI search sends you fall off the end. Every other angle means another filter and another export.

With the MCP server

 Search queries by text instead of scrolling a table
 Narrow any report to one exact page in a single call
 Pick any window from 1 to 365 days

Problem 2

### The analysis lives in a spreadsheet nobody reopens

Matching queries to pages, then pages to GA4, is manual work, so it happens once a quarter. By then the page that was decaying has already lost its clicks.

With the MCP server [...] No export, no screenshot: the agent reads the actual rows

The timeline keeps it honest: updates checked before theories

Follow-ups are one message, not another afternoon

Steal the workflow prompts →
